text:
Nikhil Rao: Heads-up from canary: observed duplicate active sessions + double quota when clients reconnect during a proxy half-close. Console shows tenants with rising active_token_seconds even after reconnect.
Emilia Fernandez: Repro steps?
Nikhil Rao: Open WS/SSE, inject proxy FIN (netem) so client reconnects to a different edge. New accept completes; old shard doesn't observe EOF so it keeps counting. Minimal logs: 
```
INFO 2026-03-23T08:12:11Z accept resume_id=rx_100 shard=eu-2 last_event=901 claim_nonce=0x1a3f
INFO 2026-03-23T08:12:11Z accept resume_id=rx_100 shard=eu-5 last_event=901 claim_nonce=0x7d2b
```
Rocco Tan: Classic claim race. We already have a session-lease/tombstone (TTL=30s) but rapid reconnects + proxy half-close cause both shards to accept before GC.
Priya Shah: UX pain: alerts and billing pages. We need both short-term mitigation in console and a reliable backend reconciliation. Thoughts?
Emilia Fernandez: Short-term: console aggregation dedupe by (tenant,resume_id) within a 60s sliding window and mark as "reconciling". Non-destructive (hide alert, keep raw numbers available in advanced view).
Nikhil Rao: Backend plan: keep optimistic increment at accept to avoid latency hit, then spawn an async reconciler task that performs an atomic claim against routing-metadata. If CAS fails, emit `quota_compensation` event with {tenant_id,resume_id,delta_seconds,reason:"duplicate_claim"}. Billing consumes that to correct counts.
Rocco Tan: Also add a soft-affinity heuristic: prefer the shard that last renewed resume_id if last_seen < 10s. This reduces cross-shard accepts without strong consistency.
Priya Shah: Good. Add metric `stream_resume_conflict` and `quota_compensation_emitted` with tags {shard,tenant,route}. Console should surface a link to the reconciliation metric on the tenant page.
Emilia Fernandez: Logs: include `claim_nonce` and `winner_nonce/loser_nonce` in reconcile logs so we can tie events together. Example: 
```
WARN 2026-03-23T08:12:11Z reconcile conflict resume_id=rx_100 winner_nonce=0x1a3f loser_nonce=0x7d2b shard=eu-2
```
Nikhil Rao: Need an admin escape hatch: operator endpoint to force-evict a resume_id for emergencies. Spec: `POST /admin/v1/resume/{resume_id}/evict?force=true&dry_run=false` returns corrected_quota delta and audit_id. Idempotent and audited.
Priya Shah: For console, add transient banner: "Possible duplicate resume activity detected 12 reconciling. Alerts muted for this window." Clickthrough to reconciler metric and admin-evict docs.
Rocco Tan: Implementation details: reconciler writes a reconciliation event with original increment ts so billing can apply compensation backward (compensations should be time-ordered). Reconciler should emit tracing span and take <500ms ideally.
Emilia Fernandez: Rollout plan: 1) claim_nonce logs + metric (Rocco) 2) async reconciler worker + `quota_compensation` event (Nikhil) 3) soft-affinity routing change (Rocco) 4) console dedupe behind feature flag + banner (Priya) 5) admin-evict API (Nikhil).
deploy-bot: Rolling: claim_nonce log PR -> canary eu-2 in 10m. Reconciler worker -> canary eu-5 in 30m. Console flag behind feature toggle.
ops-bot: Created INF-9344: "streaming: async-reconcile + console dedupe (60s) + admin-evict" assigned to Priya. ETA 4d.
Nikhil Rao: Follow-ups: watch `stream_resume_conflict` and `quota_compensation_emitted` on canary. If compensation rate > 0.5% we escalate to blocking.
Priya Shah: I'll make console dedupe opt-in for first 24h then flip based on ops signal.
Rocco Tan: I'll include unit tests for CAS path and a simulation harness for proxy half-close races.
Emilia Fernandez: Perfect. Thanks team 30 :rocket:
